prompt: Write 10 distinct notes the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual made about one member each while helping them with: a fence blown down. Each says what will help the next time this agent serves this member: how they like to be dealt with, what is still open, what to check. One or two sentences, third person, no names. This batch leans towards families with young children. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 2)
response: {"items":[{"type":"preference","content":"Prefers a calm, reassuring tone and plain English, as she was juggling the call around two young children and found the step-by-step explanation easiest to follow."},{"type":"observation","content":"The fence was blown down in strong winds and the garden panel appears to be the main issue; no evidence was given of impact damage from a vehicle or of any wider structural loss."},{"type":"fact","content":"Open item: obtain clear photographs of the full fence line and any detached posts before any temporary repair is arranged, so the extent of the storm damage can be checked."},{"type":"preference","content":"Likes short updates by text rather than long calls, as she may not be able to answer during school run and bedtime."},{"type":"observation","content":"The member seemed most concerned about making the garden safe for children and pets, so any interim fencing or hazard advice should be prioritised."},{"type":"fact","content":"Check whether the damaged fence is on the insured boundary and whether any shared boundary responsibility applies before authorising replacement."},{"type":"preference","content":"Responded well to being told exactly what would happen next and when, and did not want to repeat the same details twice."},{"type":"observation","content":"There was mention of loose timber and broken fixings, so the next handler should confirm whether the posts have also failed or whether only panels need replacing."},{"type":"fact","content":"Open item: confirm the age and type of the fence, as that may affect whether like-for-like repair or full section replacement is appropriate within delegated authority."},{"type":"preference","content":"Preferred practical guidance over lengthy policy discussion, especially about securing the garden safely while waiting for a contractor or assessor."}]}
